candidate.text: Fix handling of certificates with IP addresses in the `commonName` field; IP addresses are no longer added to the DNS `subjectAlternativeName` list and are instead added to the `ipAddresses` field as expected. (`#7081`, `@johnjcool`)

evidence.excerpt: - Fix handling of certificates with IP addresses in the `commonName` field; IP addresses are no longer added to the DNS `subjectAlternativeName` list and are instead added to the `ipAddresses` field as expected. ([`#7081`](https://github.com/cert-manager/cert-manager/pull/7081), [`@johnjcool`](https://github.com/johnjcool))
